steps.name: Fragments of the Mirror's Memory
steps.objective: View the memories of the past in front of the place where Belial was, then press the [Complete Quest] button to finish the quest.

lines.text: (A hazy memory surfaces from some unknown point in Devesis' past.)

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: So Creed has people like you, too. Your will is stronger than that of the creatures in the Demon Realm.
I am prepared, demon Belial.

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: You summon a high-ranking demon, and that is how you ask a favor?
Aaargh... All... All right! Aaargh!
I-I will do as you wish, Lady Belial.

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Will you? Very well.

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: As a special exception, I won't take your soul this time. Your arrival couldn't have worked out better.

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Step into this mirror. Your ancestral god, Ignore, whom you have been waiting for, should be inside.

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Go and see him.

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: How fortunate. I was never certain what becomes of someone who kills a god.

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Whatever your intentions, you will end up killing the ancestral god I imprisoned long ago. That is how this mirror was made.
Don't tell me you brought me here to...

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Hehe. Sadly, I missed it that time. I'll be watching you from here.

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: You don't mind, do you, Talos?

steps.name: An Unexpected Connection
steps.objective: Find [Raselis] in 「Devesis」 and watch the story, then press the [Complete Quest] button to finish the quest.

lines.speaker: 라셀리스
lines.text: Such a beauty, really.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Chef, are you talking about me?

lines.speaker: 라셀리스
lines.text: No. What on earth makes you think I mean you, Patello?

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: Then me? Me?

lines.speaker: 라셀리스
lines.text: You're cute, Shuvie.

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: Hehe, thanks.

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: Juriring, the chef says you're beautiful.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Thank you, Chef. Ring!

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: I hear you helped us out. Come here whenever you're hungry and put your meal on my tab.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Really? Ring? Can I really come and eat anything I want? Ring?

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Has everyone you've ever met lied to you?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Hooray! Three cheers for Patello! Ring!

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Now there's someone who understands me.

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: Juriring, let's go looking for gems in the mine together sometime. It'll be fun.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Oh, I'd love to! Ring! Let's go together. Ring!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Juriring said it was a dream to share a meal with the people of Devesis... And now it's come true.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But why isn't anyone surprised to see such a huge Priring?

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Um... %s, it's been... a while.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: Well, %s, many of the mages researching in the tower are rather eccentric. We have our share of incidents.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: So Juriring showing up doesn't seem like much of a fuss...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What sort of incidents?

lines.speaker: 라셀리스
lines.text: Patello once showed us a golem he'd built as a kitchen assistant. It went berserk and demolished the shop.

lines.speaker: 라셀리스
lines.text: Then he enchanted a gem-cutting machine to run by itself. Gem fragments shot into the sky over Devesis and burst like fireworks.

lines.speaker: 라셀리스
lines.text: And then Patello...

lines.speaker: 라셀리스
lines.text: Come to think of it, Patello also...

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: Why is Uncle Patello involved in every single disaster?

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Hahaha! Such is the fate of a genius mage, isn't it? I'm not the only one who's caused trouble!

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: Honestly, Patello. You ought to reflect on your behavior.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Yes, teacher.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Um... %s? Excuse me...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? Elliot? Elliot, it's been so long!

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Hello... %s... So this is where you were.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where have you been? You suddenly disappeared. I was worried.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did you go back to the magical beasts' habitat?

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: An acquaintance of yours, %s? Pleased to meet you. I'm Marta, something of a village chief here in Devesis.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: I'm Elliot...

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: Wow... You're so pretty... My name's Shuvie.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: N-no, I'm not. You're prettier, Sh-Shuvie.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Um... The road to Linford seems to have disappeared... Do you know anything about it...?

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: I couldn't find the road from Whispering Hill...

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Linford?

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Aaaah! A h-huge Priring!!

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: I'm Juriring. Ring!

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Wait. Did you say Linford? One of the fragments of the Celestial Realm?

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: Elliot, about Linford...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why are you and Patello so surprised, Marta?

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: Well, you see...

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Oh, I know that Linford! Ring! The place that was cursed ten years ago...
